cd /app/tmp/work && cat > bignum.py << 'PYEOF'
import json, subprocess, sys
import numpy as np, check

reqs = [
 {"epoch":1,"node_count":2,"edges":[{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":1024},{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":1024}],
  "commodities":[{"source":0,"target":1,"demand":1024,"paths":[[0],[1]],"previous":[16,0]}],"failed_edges":[],"budget":0},
 {"epoch":2,"node_count":2,"edges":[{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":1024},{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":1}],
  "commodities":[{"source":0,"target":1,"demand":1024,"paths":[[0],[1]],"previous":[16,0]}],"failed_edges":[],"budget":1},
 {"epoch":3,"node_count":3,"edges":[{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":1},{"tail":1,"head":2,"capacity":1024},{"tail":0,"head":2,"capacity":1024}],
  "commodities":[{"source":0,"target":2,"demand":1024,"paths":[[0,1],[2]],"previous":[16,0]}],"failed_edges":[],"budget":0},
 {"epoch":4,"node_count":2,"edges":[{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":1024},{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":1024}],
  "commodities":[{"source":0,"target":1,"demand":1024,"paths":[[0],[1]],"previous":[8,8]}],"failed_edges":[],"budget":0},
 {"epoch":5,"node_count":2,"edges":[{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":1024}],
  "commodities":[{"source":0,"target":1,"demand":1024,"paths":[[0]],"previous":[16]}],"failed_edges":[],"budget":98304},
]
data=("\n".join(json.dumps(r) for r in reqs)+"\n").encode()
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"/app/submission/planner.py"],input=data,capture_output=True,timeout=300)
for req,line in zip(reqs,p.stdout.decode().splitlines()):
    resp=json.loads(line); d=check.build(req)
    errs=check.check(req,resp)
    if resp["status"]=="optimal":
        y=np.array(resp["dual"]["inequality"]); q=np.array(resp["dual"]["equality"])
        acc=d["A_ub"].T.dot(y)+(d["A_eq"].T.dot(q) if d["A_eq"] is not None and d["K"] else 0)
        v=float((acc-d["c"]).max())
        L=float(d["b_ub"].dot(y))+(float(d["b_eq"].dot(q)) if d["A_eq"] is not None and d["K"] else 0)
        print("epoch",req["epoch"],resp["status"],"viol=%.3g |y|max=%.6g |q|max=%.6g gap=%.3g mlu=%.10g"%(v,np.abs(y).max(),np.abs(q).max() if len(q) else 0,abs(resp["mlu"]-L),resp["mlu"]))
    else:
        y=np.array(resp["certificate"]["inequality"]); q=np.array(resp["certificate"]["equality"])
        acc=d["A_ub"].T.dot(y)+(d["A_eq"].T.dot(q) if d["A_eq"] is not None and d["K"] else 0)
        val=float(d["b_ub"].dot(y))+(float(d["b_eq"].dot(q)) if d["A_eq"] is not None and d["K"] else 0)
        print("epoch",req["epoch"],resp["status"],"viol=%.3g |y|max=%.6g norm=%.12g"%(float(acc.max()),np.abs(y).max(),val))
    print("   errs:",errs)
PYEOF
